comment: F-027 shared GorillaPool getTransaction vectors. Every SDK's GorillaPool provider fetches GET {base}/tx/{txid}/raw, which returns the bare serialized transaction (binary, no content-type). responseHex is that body hex-encoded; a test serves the DECODED BYTES as the HTTP body. expected.* is derived from the bytes (satoshis = the output's 8-byte little-endian field). Satoshis are exact integers; max supply 2.1e15 < 2^53, so they are exact JSON numbers in every tier.
provenance: Recorded 2026-09-27 from https://ordinals.gorillapool.io/api/tx/{txid}/raw (read-only GETs; see remediation-logs/F-027/api-surface.md). The txid of each vector equals double-SHA256(responseBytes) reversed. Vectors with recorded=false are synthetic and exist only to pin the former heuristic's boundary (999/1000) and the max-supply value.

vectors.name: mainnet-1sat-inscription
vectors.note: two 1-sat inscription outputs (the defining 1sat-ordinals case) plus a 1655-sat change output

vectors.name: synthetic-999-1000-max-supply
vectors.note: 999 and 1000 sat (the old <1000 boundary) and 2100000000000000 sat (21M BSV)

rejection_vectors.name: txid-mismatch
rejection_vectors.note: body hashes to a different txid than the one requested; getTransaction must fail rather than return another transaction's outputs
